name: Dalaran Status Report
summary: At Ambermill, the Kirin Tor rebuild Dalaran in the open, while the Deathstalkers seek their report.

sections.title: Eyes on the Rebuilding City
sections.body:
During the Third War, the Scourge sacked Dalaran, and Archimonde brought down its towering spires. Early in the rebuilding, the surviving magi removed the city's protective shield and began their work in the open.

The Kirin Tor keeps enclaves such as Ambermill in southeastern Silverpine Forest. Its wizards compile the Dalaran Status Report, which records the city's condition. The Deathstalkers seek its intelligence.

sections.title: A Deathstalker's Test
sections.body:
Lord Varimathras watches for Alliance and Kirin Tor remnants, guarding Forsaken control of Lordaeron with constant vigilance. Forsaken interrogators forced admissions from a captured Kirin Tor mage, and the dreadlord ordered the Deathstalkers to secure the report.

The document lies in a locked strongbox deep inside Ambermill. Newly initiated rogues also retrieve it as a rite of passage, mastering lockpicking under Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter.

faq.q: What is the Dalaran Status Report?
faq.answer: The Dalaran Status Report is a set of confidential Kirin Tor documents on Dalaran's condition, recovery work, and current status. Mages at the Ambermill outpost compiled it.

aliases: how to find the status report
faq.answer: The report is locked in a strongbox in Ambermill, in southeastern Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why does the Undercity want this report?
faq.answer: Lord Varimathras and the Forsaken see the surviving Kirin Tor as an active threat on their doorstep. The report helps the Deathstalkers assess Dalaran's military strength and secret reconstruction work.

faq.q: How did the Deathstalkers learn about the document?
faq.answer: A captured Kirin Tor prisoner questioned in the Undercity told the Deathstalkers about the document and where it was kept.

angles.text: As a rogue, you prove your lockpicking and infiltration skills under Mennet Carkad by retrieving the report from vigilant mages.
As an undead, you know the Kirin Tor remnants at Ambermill trouble the Forsaken in Silverpine. Intelligence on their operations matters to Undercity's security.
